title: Pirini Ponders: August 2019
summary: A healthy eating project, staff health checks, literacy in the children's ministry and the finished hospital school extensions.
body:
Greetings to you all. We have had a busy couple of months with visits from friends and family, which has been a real blessing. Our daughter Charlotte visited for a couple of weeks and we spent a weekend camping Solomons style, with snorkelling, swimming and an early mountain climb to see the sunrise.

The healthy eating and nutrition project has been a great success this month and well received by SWIM staff and families. Emma, from Kingston church in Tasmania, stayed for three weeks. She wrote up log charts, trialled healthy recipes and cooked with Betty. She also helped design and build an outside oven with a chimney and bamboo pipe that takes smoke out of the cooking hut.

Charlotte's nursing skills helped with staff health checks: glucose, urine, weight and BMI measurements, blood pressure and a questionnaire on eating and exercise. Staff rotated through the stations and finished with morning tea and cake, followed by a talk on healthy diets and lifestyle.

The Wednesday evening children's ministry has started again, with a focus on teaching literacy using phonics, actions and alphabet signs for the deaf. Some adults who cannot read are also taking part, and more than 50 people came on the first night. Thanks to Ana, one of our SWIM family, for leading this.

The hospital school extensions are complete and look amazing. Ron and the building team attended the official opening and lunch.

Otherwise it has been business as usual, with a busy July school holidays hosting several teams and ongoing maintenance of the base. Please feel free to drop us a line with your news.

All our love and God's blessings, Ron and Tanya
